purpose:
Development-only model-domain and conditional free-rollout diagnostics.

Uses recorded native states, requested inputs and frozen saved model snapshots.
No physics, fitting, model selection, simulator queries or held-out data access.
future_input_semantics: Multi-step forecasts are offline diagnostics conditioned on the recorded future requested sequence. They do not assume an online controller knows future feedback-selected actions.
prefix_semantics: The reference is established at the paid prefix endpoint; prefix interactions remain in the input budget but are excluded from local-model forecast windows.
persistence_semantics: Keep initial velocity fixed and advance position by dt times that velocity; no learned coefficients or future states.
sample_semantics: Windows overlap, share seeds and reuse controller trajectories; their counts are denominators, not independent experimental samples.
coverage_semantics: Calibration ranges are axis-aligned feature envelopes, not convex hulls, identifiable contact modes or safety sets. Amplitude and state cohorts label window start only.
calibration_semantics: Final-model predictions on calibration are in-sample post-fit diagnostics, distinct from the recorded predict-before-update online errors.
model_selection: No model is fitted or selected by this script; only development data are accepted.
